data.gender_notes: Elizabet is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Elisheba means 'My God is an oath', and Bet means 'house'. In Greek, Elizabet means 'God is my oath, God's promise'. The name was borne by several biblical women and saints. The name Elizabet carries the meaning “God's promise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elizabet usually hope their child will grow to embody god's promise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's promises and covenants.
data.etymology: Elizabet belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's promise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elizabet total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אליזבט
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא הבורא שלי, אלוהים הוא שבועתי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליזבט הוא השם העברי הנגזר מהשם אלישבע, שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא הבורא שלי' או 'אלוהים הוא שבועתי'. השם אליזבט מורכב מהמילים 'אל' ו'ישבע', שפירושם 'אלוהים' ו'שבועה' בהתאמה. השם אליזבט הוא מקור חשוב לשם אליזבת, הנמצא בברית החדשה ומתייחס לאליזבת, אמו של יוחנן המטביל.

in_greek.name: Ελισάβετ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι η υπόσχεσή μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ελισάβετ είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Εליזבט, που προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα אלישבע. Το όνομα σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι η υπόσχεσή μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι ο όρκος μου'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ελισάβετ αναφέρεται στη μητέρα του Ιωάννη του Βαπτιστή, που ήταν ξαδέλφη της Παναγίας.

in_latin.name: Elizabet
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elizabet derivatur ex nomine hebraeo אלישבע, quod significat 'Deus est ius iurandum meum' vel 'Deus est creator meus'. Nomen Elizabet in Ecclesia primitiva christiana usitatum erat, et Elisabet, mater Ioannis Baptistae, in Novum Testamentum refertur.

in_english.name: Elizabet
in_english.meaning: God is my oath or God is my creator
in_english.long_meaning: The name Elizabet originates from the Hebrew name אלישבע (Elisheva), meaning 'God is my oath' or 'God is my creator'. It is derived from the words 'אל' (El), meaning 'God', and 'ישבע' (yishva), meaning 'oath' or 'promise'. In Christian tradition, Elizabet is associated with Elizabeth, the mother of John the Baptist, mentioned in the New Testament. The name symbolizes faithfulness, devotion, and spiritual commitment. Throughout history, the name Elizabet has been popularized in various forms across cultures, reflecting its enduring significance in Christian heritage.
